'''Valerius''' is the surveyor at the Echo Depository in [[Averardo Vault]]. He is fascinated by Echoes, unlike his co-worker, [[Aurelius]]. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Valerius:''' Same as always today. No irregularities in the Echoes' frequencies.
:{{DIcon}}: Hello. What are you doing?
:'''Valerius:''' Greetings, my name is Valerius. I am the surveyor here at the Echo Depository. 
:'''Valerius:''' This area of the depository uses cutting-edge technology developed by the [[Montelli Family|Montelli family]]. Echoes are secured on mountings, allowing them to be preserved without requiring dedicated Terminals.
:'''Valerius:''' That said, it's still new technology. We still need to be monitoring their resting frequencies around the clock so any anomalies can be dealt with swiftly.
:{{DIcon}}: Hold on, you're saying...
:{{DIcon}}: These Echoes could hypothetically escape?
:'''Valerius:''' Haha, well, from what I know of the Montellis, the chances of that happening are about as likely as the entire population of Ragunna suddenly developing a taste for [[Pizza Tropicale]]!
:'''Valerius:''' Still, imagine if all these magnificent specimens―frozen in place―suddenly came to life. Now that would be a sight to see.
:'''Valerius:''' Many of the Echoes here are types I could never hope to see in my lifetime. Some of them are extinct, officially declared as such by the outside world.
:'''Valerius:''' To witness them move, even once... That's all I could ever ask for as a researcher in the field of Echoes.
{{Dialogue End}}
